proposed.text: Which statement correctly compares Pratt and Howe trusses in BCI?

options.text: Pratt uses vertical web members in compression and diagonal web members in tension; Howe reverses that relationship.
Both Pratt and Howe use only flat parallel chords with no diagonals.
Howe trusses are acoustical ceiling systems.
Pratt trusses are ceramic tile setting beds.

proposed.rationale: BCI distinguishes Pratt and Howe trusses by which web members are in tension and compression.
